card.name: Digits inside longer numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle or end of a multi-digit number, such as a ZIP code, a reference numeral, a year, or a section number. It is most often the last or second-to-last digit.

modes.label: ZIP codes and addresses
modes.description: A digit inside a five-digit US postal code after a city and state.

modes.label: Reference numerals and years
modes.description: A digit ending a patent-style reference number or a year before AD.
